visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit indoor bouldering gym. A young girl with her hair in pigtails is seen from the side, wearing a white t-shirt and black leggings, cautiously climbing a wooden wall studded with red and pink geometric holds. Beside her stands an adult woman in a grey t-shirt and black pants, watching closely with a focused expression. The gym has a neutral color palette with industrial-style lighting and tables and stools in the background. (2) The camera pans and cuts to show the girl higher up on the wall, reaching for holds with small, deliberate hand movements. The woman gives a thumbs-up to the camera, smiling broadly. Later, the girl reaches the top and prepares to descend. The floor is covered with a thick, grey protective mat. White text overlays appear at the bottom of the screen. (3) An adult man wearing glasses and a grey t-shirt attempts to climb a much steeper section of the wall featuring large, blue and orange holds. He reaches out with his right arm but loses his grip and falls backward onto the mat. The young girl is seen from above, standing on the mat and looking toward the man. (4) The final phase shows the young girl sitting on a striped cushion on the mat. She holds her arm as if in slight pain while the woman examines her hand. A plastic cup containing a white frozen slushy with a metal straw is placed in front of her. The girl takes a sip from the straw, her expression shifting from discomfort to a slight smile. The background remains the gym's interior with other climbers visible in the distance.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with bright, rhythmic acoustic guitar strumming at a moderate tempo. A friendly male voice narrates with clear articulation and high emotional valence. There is a background layer of muffled gym chatter and room resonance. (2) A distinct thudding sound occurs as the child lands on the mat. The music continues uninterrupted. Female voices are heard in the background, offering encouragement with rising intonations. (3) A sudden, louder percussive impact sound marks the adult man falling. The male narrator's tone becomes more comedic and slightly louder. A child's high-pitched voice is heard cheering rhythmically. (4) The music softens slightly as the child's voice speaks softly, indicating pain. A wet, slurping sound is clearly audible as she drinks. The track ends with a gentle acoustic chord and the sound of distant laughter.
